name: fl-star-tcp
description: START HERE. Federated learning, 1 server + 2 clients, every link over plain TCP/IP — the wiring for a testbed with no antenna attached.

nodes.note: the hub: collects one model from EVERY client, FedAvgs once, answers all of them with the same global model. Start this node first.
no radio section: this node has no USRP and needs none, because both directions of its link are tcp

links.note: up = c0 -> srv (the local model), down = srv -> c0 (the aggregate)
